messages:
Maria: quick heads-up — PR #412 updated the SDK examples for streaming + pagination + retry behavior. Linking preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 :eyes:
Kevin: on it. what's the scope? python/ts/go?
Maria: all three. small API changes: streaming now uses async iterators in Py, TS uses ReadableStream, Go example switches to channel-based streaming. Also updated retry guidance to recommend exponential backoff + jitter and to show idempotency hints for pagination.
Kevin: can you paste the new python snippet here? I want to validate patterns for `streaming_callback`.
Maria: sure — here's the py example from the PR:

```python
async for chunk in client.responses.stream("gpt-4o-mini"):
    if chunk.type == "token":
        print(chunk.text, end="")
```

Maria: also added example with retry wrapper:

```python
async def robust_stream():
    for attempt in range(3):
        try:
            async for c in client.responses.stream("gpt-4o-mini"):
                yield c
            break
        except TransientError:
            await asyncio.sleep((2 ** attempt) + random.random())
            continue
```

Aj: for Go I swapped to using a channel + context cancel. snippet:

```go
ch := make(chan string)
go func() {
    defer close(ch)
    for resp := range client.Stream(ctx, req) {
        ch <- resp.Text
    }
}()
for tok := range ch {
    fmt.Print(tok)
}
```

Sam: For TS, changed to async iterator + stream pipe to DOM — preview in PR has `ReadableStream` example.
Kevin: main ask: ensure pagination sample shows `cursor` handling + item dedup note. I can add a small helper for python and ts.
Maria: added TODO for link fixes — some `examples/pagination.md` anchors changed. CI preview: https://deployments.redwood.ai/previews/412 :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: preview build succeeded — https://deployments.redwood.ai/previews/412/1 :package:
Kevin: left a few inline comments about naming and docstrings. I'll push fixes later today.
Aj: also flagged an edgecase where retry on streaming partial failures should not restart from scratch if KV cache present. Suggest adding note.
Maria: good catch, added a short paragraph. Can we get a tech review from runtime team? @Aj can you +1 after one more pass?
Aj: +1 after I remove the small race condition in the Go sample.
Sam: I'll do a quick follow-up PR to the example app linking to the docs change.
Maria: sweet. target merge by EOD unless any new blockers. thx all :tada:
Kevin: :thumbsup:
